---
title: "Process limma"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-15"
---


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

Path to file
```{r}
path <- "./tPx Final Outputs/H1.0 vs IVS10_16 exclusions-TRUE NAThreshold-0.4.csv"
save_path <- paste0(gsub(".csv", "", path)," genes mapped.csv")
```

Load report.pg_matrix (has ProteinID <-> Gene mappings), take metadata, add pSiteID column
```{r}
report <- read.delim("report.pg_matrix.tsv")
gene_mapper <- report[,1:3]
```

Load limma data
```{r}
limma <- read.csv(path)

colnames(limma)[1] <- "Protein.Group"
```

Left join in gene info from the mapper, reorder columns, and sort by P.Value
```{r}
limma <- left_join(limma, gene_mapper, by = "Protein.Group") %>% 
  select(c(Protein.Group, Protein.Names, Genes), everything()) %>% 
  arrange(limma$P.Value)
```

Save updated limma file
```{r}
write.csv(limma, save_path)
```
